pll2d3c5-d1e3514.summary: Asks what wisdom the angels had before fall or confirmation.

pll2d3c5-d1e3517.summary: Answers: a threefold natural knowledge, that they were made, by whom, and with whom; and some knowledge of good and evil, what to seek and what to reject.
claims: Angels knew good and evil in some measure.

pl-l2d3c5.summary: Asks what wisdom the angels had before fall or confirmation: a threefold natural knowledge, of what they were made, by whom, and with whom, and some knowledge of good and evil, what to seek and what to reject.
claims: Angels had natural knowledge of what they were, who made them, and with whom they were made.
Angels had some knowledge of good and evil.
